Nina (CS): MonarchPay renewal next week. They want a short customer runbook for demo windows: fast warmup, safe fallbacks, and a 2-question post-demo survey. Can eng + sre + solutions give a compact checklist we can send them?

Diego (Eng): Keep it 3 bullets for customers: 1) Prefill common prompts 15m before demo to prime KV cache. 2) Use a transient warm pool sized to expected concurrency. 3) Enable simple fallback routing to a smaller quantized model. Prefill curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '"{\"tenant_id\":\"monarchpay-prod\",\"prompts\":[\"balance overview\",\"last 3 tx\"]}"'```

Sam (SRE): Ops notes for them (and our on-call): - Set alert: queue_depth > 40 or p95 > 750ms during demo window. - Temp autoscale +1 instance for 30m around demo. - If fallback engaged, route 5% to primary for quality checks. Sample alert rule: `p95_latency{tenant="monarchpay-prod"} > 0.75 for 2m`

Leah (Solutions): Customer-facing checklist (one-pager): 1) Confirm demo time and grant prefill permission. 2) Run smoke 24h prior (share 5 sample prompts). 3) On demo day: run prefill 15m prior, start warm pool, run a short demo. Post-demo survey (embedded): Q1: Latency acceptable? (Yes/No). Q2: Any output issues? (optional free text). We'll capture results in the account ticket.

ops-bot: deployment: warm-pool-tweak -> canary (id: c-9921). ETA 2m.

Nina (CS): Perfect. Action items: @Diego provide prefill sample and confirm KV hit thresholds; @Sam add temporary alerts and bump autoscale; @Leah send checklist + survey link. I'll confirm times with MonarchPay PM and mark renewal risk = Monitor.

Diego (Eng): Confirmed. I'll run staging prefill and post a quick KV hit stat after.

Sam (SRE): Staging results: cache_hit rate -> 71% after prefill, p95 ~ 130ms for cached requests. I'll standby for the demo window.

Nina (CS): Thanks team — I'll close this thread after the smoke and attach survey + perf summary to the renewal ticket.
